app.title: Minipg: PostgreSQL as a Single Executable
app.description: A lightweight single-binary PostgreSQL-compatible database designed for simplicity and portability.
proposed_tests: Download the minipg binary and start a database instance
Create a test database and table via SQL
Insert 1000 rows and measure write latency
Execute a SELECT query with filtering and measure read latency
Compare performance against a local PostgreSQL instance
